mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 2.5% over two consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the effect reverses when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly below zero during such episodes (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 6.5% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below 95 for three consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate earnings and capital expenditure, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO contraction episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS above 135,000 and a fall in UNRATE below 6.0% over the same month indicates a labor market expansion with softening wage pressure, which supports corporate margins and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 135000 AND UNRATE < 6.0% in the same month
regime_hint: labor market expansion with soft wage growth
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during such joint conditions (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in HOUST above 800 and a rise in RSAFS above 400,000 in the same month signals strong housing demand and consumer spending, which boosts retail and construction sector earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 800 AND RSAFS > 400000 in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive in triggered months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in CPIAUCSL below 1.5% for four consecutive months signals low inflation and a high likelihood of accommodative Fed policy, which lowers discount rates and supports higher equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly above zero during such episodes (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in GDPC1 above 2.5% quarter-over-quarter in the most recent release signals a strong demand rebound after a prior contraction, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ > 2.5% after previous quarter's GDPC1 QoQ < -0.5%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive following such rebounds (t-test p > 0.05).
